notes.title: Build a quick learning note app
notes.body: User wants a floating note app that supports learning projects, automatic associative memory network generation, and knowledge tree construction.

notes.title: Use dependency-free local web app first
notes.body: Python and gh are unavailable in the current environment, so the first implementation uses native HTML/CSS/JS with localStorage to keep the app runnable without dependency installation.

notes.title: Add Windows desktop floating note executable
notes.body: Added a WPF .NET desktop app under learning-memory-notes/desktop-floating-note. It launches as a topmost draggable floating note window independent of the browser and stores notes in %APPDATA%/MemoryNotes/notes.json.

notes.title: Default project data to E drive
notes.body: User prefers all project data to default to E drive. Desktop MemoryNotes now stores notes at E:/MemoryNotes/data/notes.json when E drive is available, with an AppData fallback.
